runtime.implementation: WPF self-contained Store client (canonical) + Cloud Run broker portal

orchestrator.purpose: Sequence the repair experience by invoking attached Orbs across their Umbilicals. Owns phase/session state only; holds no diagnostic or repair logic of its own.

holds_contracts.role: The Orchestrator HOLDS the action envelope (owned/authored by the repair-engine Orb) and KEYS the repair-plan Umbilical to it. Holding a declarative admissibility contract and enforcing the keying is orchestration, NOT repair logic: the Orchestrator never decides what to repair, only that any plan crossing the Umbilical satisfies the envelope. At scan->plan it compiles the per-machine admissible action set (preconditions x diagnostics) and hands it to the attached author; at plan->consent the keyed envelope is the guard on the transition; at consent it renders risk / requires_restart / estimated_mb from the envelope, not from model output — so every sign the user approves has a real referent.

evidence.source: Opened clean from the Manifest-of-Completion audit (5 PASS / 3 FAIL / 4 PARTIAL / 4 UNVERIFIABLE). Places audit-passing elements as provisional Orbs; declares FAIL/redesign items as draft Orbs to be built clean.
